description: The punctuality of the favourite trains from the runs recorded on this phone: the days of the personal record and of the trend, the background recording of each favourite's final delay (once a day after its scheduled arrival, with retries) and the Sunday weekly digest (when it may show, its quiet hours, the weeks it compares and the drop that names a train). The rules are the cases of contracts/shared-rules/v1/favourite-punctuality-v1.json.
